name: article_grabber
description: Signal scraper. An SQS-triggered Lambda: reads one site's RSS feed, fetches and summarizes each new article, and writes it to DynamoDB.

scripts.test: echo "No unit tests for the scraper" && exit 1
scripts.invoke: node --input-type=module -e "import('./article_grabber.js').then(m => m.handler({ Records: [{ body: JSON.stringify({ username: 'local', website: process.argv[1], mode: process.argv[2] || 'default' }) }] })).then(r => console.log('result:', r))"
